data.description:
## Bug

test_integration_mandatory_prompts in tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh fails on main (pre-existing, confirmed via git stash).

## Observed
Test checks that onboarding SKILL.md has:
- 'MANDATORY PROMPT' near Jira Bridge section
- 'MANDATORY PROMPT.*always ask' near Figma section
- Gate note referencing sections 8/9 as mandatory

None present in onboarding SKILL.md.

## Expected
Sections 8 (Jira) and 9 (Figma) should have MANDATORY PROMPT directives so the model always asks rather than pre-deciding to skip.

## Impact
Test suite has a known failure on main. Tracked via RED marker at test_jekyll_git_clone_path boundary (covers both tests since test_integration_mandatory_prompts appears after it).
data.title: [test-onboarding-skill]: test_integration_mandatory_prompts fails — onboarding SKILL.md missing MANDATORY PROMPT directives
